title: events/types/mutation.rejected
description: Payload for event_type 'mutation.rejected' (feature 016; FR-1407/1410): a proposal or pending candidate failed a deterministic gate. The gate that refused it is named; violations are enumerated.

gate.description: schema = unparseable/invalid proposal; stale = base_revision != active hash; vacuous = ops changed nothing; validation = mutated doc fails pack/policy/inventory/class checks; boundary = candidate failed re-validation at install time; budget = op count over pack max_ops.

violations.description: Named reasons — never a bare refusal.
